edge_case_summary: Hospital prefab modules (10m × 4m × 4m, 28t each): weather-deck capacity required for 4m-height oversize modules — verifies matcher flags vessels where hold height clearance fails and deck stowage is the only viable option.

cargo_inquiries.hold_geometry_required: modules 10m × 4m × 4m height; hold clear height must be ≥4.5m; alternatively weather-deck stowage with securing acceptable
restrictions: Weather-deck stowage acceptable as primary or supplementary
Modules are prefab buildings — no compression loads; cradles required

vessel_positions.hatch_dimensions: Hold 1: 24m × 9m, clear height 3.8m. Hold 2: 18m × 9m, clear height 3.6m. Open deck available.
Hold 1: 28m × 10m, clear height 5.2m. Hold 2: 22m × 10m, clear height 5.0m. Deck reinforced 6t/m².

readiness.explanation: M/V Suffolk Carrier opens Tilbury 06-Jun. Tilbury to Felixstowe ~60nm at 13.0kn = ~5h, arrives same day. 3 days before laycan start 09-Jun. HOLD_HEIGHT_VIOLATION: Hold 1 clear height 3.8m and Hold 2 3.6m — both < required 4.5m. Modules 4m tall cannot be stowed below deck. Weather-deck stowage required for all 6 modules. Open deck available but vessel must confirm deck area and securing capacity.
date_issues: HOLD_HEIGHT_VIOLATION: max clear height 3.8m < required 4.5m. All 6 modules must be deck-stowed. Deck area and cradle securing confirmation required.

readiness.explanation: M/V Thames Project opens Felixstowe 07-Jun — at load port. 2 days before laycan start 09-Jun. Hold 1 clear height 5.2m and Hold 2 5.0m — both > required 4.5m. Crane 2×45t satisfies 35t lift. Previous prefab cargo experience. Tight but ideal positioning.

M/V Kent Mariner opens Tilbury 05-Jun. Tilbury to Felixstowe ~60nm at 12.5kn = ~5h, arrives ~05-Jun — 4 days before laycan start 09-Jun. Hold clear height 8.5m > 4.5m required — adequate. However hatch length 13m < module length 10m (close fit). NOTE: crane_config 4×25t — max single hook 25t < required 35t lift. CRANE_VIOLATION.
date_issues: CRANE_VIOLATION: 4×25t max single hook 25t < required 35t per module. HOLD_GEOMETRY_NOTE: hatch 13m marginally accommodates 10m module but only 3m clearance per end.
